notes.title: Playtest Update and What’s Next!
notes.content: [h3]Hello everyone,[/h3][h3]1️⃣ We’d like to inform you that the [b]Playtest version[/b] previously available is no longer accessible. Unfortunately, a major bug made the game unplayable, and at this stage, fixing it would not be worth the effort compared to focusing on the core development.[/h3][p][/p][h3]2️⃣ We also want to sincerely thank you for the [b]310 wishlists[/b] our game has already received! Your support means the world to us and keeps us motivated to work even harder.[/h3][p][/p][h3]3️⃣ Looking ahead: before the end of this year we’ll be announcing the [b]release date of our Demo[/b] 🎉.[/h3][p][/p][h3] We hope to count on your support during this stage, as your feedback will be crucial to improve the game and shape it according to what players truly want.[/h3][h3][b]Thank you all for your patience, trust, and continued support![/b] 💙[/h3]

notes.title: PlayTest starts tomorrow!
notes.content:
[h2][b][u]Dear players,[/u][/b][/h2]

We're thrilled to announce that the playtest for [b]Store Life Simulator[/b] will begin this [b]Sunday, May 4th[/b]!

[list]
[*] Please note that the game is currently in a [b]very raw alpha stage[/b] and is being developed by a single person. This playtest aims to shape the game according to players' preferences, creating an experience that truly meets the community's expectations.
[/list]

The playtest has no scheduled end date. The more feedback we receive from the community, the longer we'll keep the playtest running, as each new update may bring new issues that will need to be fixed based on your valuable input.

Join us, play, have fun, and help us build the best Store Life Simulator possible!


Sincerely,

[b]Insight Game Studio[/b]

notes.title: 🚀 Join the Playtest for Store Life Simulator! 🛒
notes.content:
[p]We have some [b]great news[/b] for you! Soon, we will be starting an [b]exclusive playtest[/b] for [u]Store Life Simulator[/u], and you can be part of it! 🎮[/p]

[p]If you enjoy management simulators and want to help shape the future of the game, this is your chance! During the playtest, you will be able to experience some of the key mechanics of the game, test new features, and give us your feedback directly.[/p]

[h3]How to participate? 🤔[/h3]

[list]
    [*]💬 [b]Join our community:[/b] Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TQqUW4WZHP]official Discord[/url], stay up-to-date with the latest news, interact with other players, and receive instructions about the playtest!
    [*]🛍️ [b]Add the game to your Wishlist on Steam:[/b] This helps us a lot and ensures that you will be notified as soon as we have updates! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559060/Store_Life_Simulator/]Click here to add to your wishlist.[/url]
    [*]⭐ [b]Follow the game:[/b] Don't miss any important updates about development and future testing opportunities.
[/list]

[h3]🌍 Help with the game’s translation![/h3]

[p]Want to see [b]Store Life Simulator[/b] available in your language or other languages? You can contribute to the translation and help make the game accessible to players worldwide! Visit [url=https://www.localizor.com/store-life-simulator]Localizor[/url] and take part in this process! 📝[/p]

[h3]💡 Your feedback is essential![/h3]

[p]Your participation in the playtest and community makes all the difference. We are creating a game that we want everyone to love, and every suggestion or opinion helps us improve. We count on you in this journey! 🚀[/p]

[p]Thank you for the support! See you soon in [b]Store Life Simulator[/b]! 🙌[/p]

notes.title: Announcement - Store Life Simulator
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, community![/h1]        
We are proud to announce that we plan to officially release our demo between July and September 2025.
        
Our goal is to gather your feedback to ensure that the Early Access version is of high quality and free from major issues.
        
We count on you to help make this project even better! 🎉
